steps.speaker: Graves?
steps.content: He's too good to me, always looking out for my feelings and playing along with my silly act. I don't deserve him.
steps.female_content: She's too good to me, always looking out for my feelings and playing along with my silly act. I don't deserve her.

steps.speaker: Graves?
steps.content: I must have scared him with my face. I'm a monster. Friends, family, wedding...
steps.female_content: I must have scared her with my face. I'm a monster. Friends, family, wedding...

steps.speaker: Graves?
steps.content: I was never meant to have any of those things anyway.

The guests in the hall have been waiting for the couple for a long time. No. 15, growing impatient, finally goes and checks on them. She finds only Graves standing there. It doesn't take long for her to figure out what happened. Graves is talking to herself again.

steps.speaker: No. 15
steps.content: It's alright, Graves! You'll find your true love someday!

steps.speaker: Graves?
steps.content: There won't be anyone else, there's only him... and he's already done too much for me.
steps.female_content: There won't be anyone else, there's only her... and she's already done too much for me.

steps.speaker: Graves?
steps.content: I'm too greedy. I want things I have no right to ask for.

steps.speaker: Graves?
steps.content: Monsters belong in abandoned places like this.

steps.speaker: Graves?
steps.content: He looked cold and indifferent when he left—because you didn't give him enough. Nowhere near enough.
steps.female_content: She looked cold and indifferent when she left—because you didn't give her enough. Nowhere near enough.

steps.content: Graves's breathing grows rapid as her nails dig into her palms. Dark crimson patterns emerge from her wrists, climbing up her arms like burn scars, gradually consuming her entire body.

steps.speaker: No. 15
steps.content: Graves? Are you alright? What are you talking about...

steps.speaker: Graves?
steps.content: I am her. I am the part of her she can never cut away.

steps.speaker: Graves?
steps.content: She couldn't keep her lover, but the promise from the deity of love remains. It's time to begin—a wedding just for you.
